description_en: Queries the deadlock count trend based on full deadlock analysis of error logs within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询时间范围内基于错误日志全量死锁分析的死锁数量趋势
name: GetDeadlockHistogram

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

For PolarDB for MySQL instances, you must specify the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

The start time can be at most 7 days earlier than the end time.

<notice>The value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur during the serialization/deserialization procedure. The value must not be greater than 9007199254740991.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间最大不能早于结束时间 7 天。

<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The format is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
<notice>The value is of the Long type. Precision loss may occur during the serialization/deserialization procedure. The value must not be greater than 9007199254740991.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The analysis status of the task
parameters.name: status
